scope: common stable reference, not maximum capacity or definitive comparison
selection: highest eligible explored rate rounded down to a positive multiple of four, then confirmed on both variants; same absolute reference and generator limits
observer_and_resource_minimum_coverage: at least duration/3 observer samples and duration/8 resource samples; max observer gap 6 seconds
recovery_criterion: 3 consecutive full 10s active-input windows after restore with >=90% committed target throughput, zero HTTP errors, bounded accepted-not-committed and fresh healthy DB/Kafka lag sample
telemetry_control: full vs aggregate control, 2 paired blocks per variant with order reversed; 60s warmup and 60s measurement
overhead_interpretation: report per-block HTTP p95 delta and generator/observer headroom, no claim of zero overhead; >max(2ms,25% of control p95) in both blocks requires investigation before freezing
